title: Earth-Moon mass ratio
description: Essential: Correctly states the mass ratio as 6R² : R₁² or equivalent simplified form.

title: Parking orbit velocity
description: Essential: Correctly gives the linear velocity as R√(g/r) or equivalent derived form.

title: Working orbit period
description: Essential: Correctly gives the period as (2πr₁/R₁)√(6r₁/g) or equivalent derived form.

title: Apply golden substitution
description: Important: Uses GM = gR² for Earth and/or g_Moon R₁² for Moon in relevant derivations.

title: Circular motion condition
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law (F_grav = m v²/r or m ω²r) for orbital motion.

title: Interpret lunar gravity
description: Important: Correctly identifies given g_Moon = g/6 and uses it in ratio or period calculation.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Final answers are presented with correct or implied units, or dimensional analysis is shown.

title: Confuse orbit radii
description: Pitfall: Uses Earth radius R or Moon radius R₁ incorrectly in place of orbit radii r or r₁.

title: Sign or ratio error
description: Pitfall: Inverts the mass ratio (e.g., writes R₁² : 6R²) or makes algebraic sign errors in velocity/period.
